description: R1 mandates the search backend be DuckDuckGo HTML: 'WHEN invoked with a non-empty query arg, the script SHALL search DuckDuckGo HTML (free, no key) and extract >=1 real external result URL.' The spec Goal (line 6-8) and the verification-architecture table (R1 row: 'none on duckduckgo.com') both name DuckDuckGo. The implementation does NOT use DuckDuckGo at all; it queries hn.algolia.com (Hacker News Algolia API). The authoritative search source required by the spec is absent. Either the impl violates R1 or the spec was silently changed without being updated.
